name: randoz
description: RANDOZ lets any group, even complete strangers, pool their photos quickly and privately.
//: The root scripts are the one command surface for every stack: VS Code tasks, CI and Claude all call
npm run dev | build | check | test. core/ is the peer-to-peer core (Node and Bare); app/ is the Android app.
build makes a signed release APK in dist/ (see docs/BUILDING.md); build:emulator adds the emulator's architecture.
serve-apk offers the APKs in dist/ on the local network, for installing on a phone from its browser.

scripts.check: npm --prefix core run check && npm --prefix app run check
scripts.test: npm --prefix core test && npm --prefix app test
